question.problem:
$x$ is negative **or** an integer, **or** $x$ is greater than $4.$

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $N(x):$ $x$ is negative

- $I(x):$ $x$ is an integer

- $G(x):$ $x$ is greater than $4$
question.worked_solution:
The word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨.$"

Note that this sentence consists of two parts: 

- **Part 1:** $x$ is negative or an integer. This corresponds to

$$
{{x\,\text{is negative}}_{⏟}}_{N}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{x\,\text{is an integer }}_{⏟}}_{I},
$$

that is, $N∨I.$

- **Part 2:** $x$ is greater than $4.$ This corresponds to $G.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{x\,\text{is negative or an integer }}_{⏟}}_{N∨I}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{x\text{ is greater than }4}_{⏟}}_{G},
$$

that is, $N∨I∨G.$
